symptom: my button press is detected dozens of times per press and sometimes fires with nobody near it. It is wired between the pin and ground.

files.button.py:
from gpiozero import Button
button = Button(27)
button.wait_for_press()
print("pressed")

gold.diagnosis: A button to ground needs the internal pull-up plus debouncing: Button(27, pull_up=True, bounce_time=0.1).
